0022600108.text: The Washington Wizards (1-1, currently on a one-game losing streak) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-1, with a win in their latest game) for the Wizards' third game of the 2026-27 season. Washington is 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East, while Chicago is 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East. Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Watkins (knee surgery) and Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve) are out for Washington, and Claxton (hamstring) is out for Chicago, while Essengue (head bruise) is day-to-day and Williams (groin soreness) is day-to-day with a game-time decision.
